title: Battery capacity (TechPower)
intro: TechPower Industries rates its new electric-vehicle battery at 75 kWh; quality control tested 30 randomly selected batteries (the course's Bonus 7-1). From the column: x̄ = 74.863 kWh, s = 0.802 kWh, standard error 0.1465 kWh, t_{0.025, 29} = 2.045, margin of error 0.300 kWh. The 95 % interval, 74.56 to 75.16 kWh, contains the rated 75 kWh.
